Vendored frontend dependencies, served by the web image without a CDN:

- Chart.js 4.4.1 (MIT), https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
- Microsoft SignalR JavaScript 8.0.0 (MIT), https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore
- Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3 (MIT), https://github.com/twbs/icons
- Inter font (SIL Open Font License 1.1), https://github.com/rsms/inter

Keep the upstream license files with these assets. Inter's stylesheet references
the local font files in `fonts/`; Bootstrap Icons also uses local fonts.
